production_safety.rule: Do not create, claim, hand off, deploy, return, complete, cancel, or overwrite production records unless using an explicitly approved QA/test ticket and test accounts.

expected: Owner describes assignment/progress/returns/AI
IT uses Service handoff terminology
Service requires exact current MHelpDesk ticket
Solar wording shows Service-selected Solar Spotter battery setup

tests.scenario: Truck spare Help matches live controls
steps: Open Owner, IT, and Service Help
Use Show me in the app
expected: IT Help points to Truck Spares / Backups
Service Help explains USED vs RETURN UNUSED
Owner Help points to Equipment Handoffs
Show me only navigates/highlights and does not mutate records

steps: Inspect unresolved checked-out backup units and in-truck spare battery batches
expected: Outstanding truck spares contribute to Handoffs badge
Owner sees Service Tech, MHelpDesk ticket and spare description
Resolved spares disappear from outstanding view

tests.scenario: Add truck spare without changing job manifest
steps: At Ticket Summary add a Truck Spare unit
Inspect prep expected count and equipment manifest
expected: Spare is inserted as purpose BACKUP
Total prepared item count increases
Customer/job equipment_manifest remains unchanged
Manifest release validation ignores BACKUP when matching required job equipment
BACKUP requires SIM/camera visibility/storage/recording/battery readiness plus equipment-specific Ranger/Helios checks
BACKUP does not falsely require customer-email assignment, Central Station monitoring, or MHelpDesk quantity confirmation
Photo, matching tag and IT signature are still required

steps: Enter spare battery quantity for supported equipment
Save without READY then attempt handoff
expected: Supported battery types include Solar Spotter AGM/350Ah, Ranger LiTime, Helios battery box, Recon II battery
Release trigger blocks a saved spare battery batch that is not READY
Ready batches can proceed to Service handoff

tests.scenario: Return unused truck spare directly to shop
steps: Complete field call without using spare
expected: Unused BACKUP is marked returned_unused
Unit registry returns to shop_inventory
Unused BACKUP does not create a unit_returns / IT Intake record
It disappears from Service unresolved-spare card

steps: Return failed/replaced field unit through normal Return Unit to IT Intake
expected: BACKUP is marked used and remains deployed
Used BACKUP becomes eligible for normal future field-return tracking
Failed/replaced unit uses normal Service→IT Intake flow
Unresolved BACKUP cannot appear as a normal return option before it is marked used

steps: After field call enter quantity used
expected: Used quantity cannot exceed prepared quantity
Returned quantity equals prepared minus used
Batch status becomes resolved
Unused remainder no longer appears as in-truck spare

steps: Owner assigns QA service ticket with IT→Service handoff
IT adds BACKUP unit and optional spare battery batch
Resolve one spare unused or used
expected: Job manifest remains job equipment only
Truck spare travels under same MHelpDesk reference
Service must explicitly resolve spare after call
Owner can see outstanding spare until resolution
Unused spare bypasses IT Intake; used/replaced field equipment follows normal return chain

last_release_qa_note: Truck spare workflow added: IT BACKUP units and spare batteries are ticket-linked, Service resolves USED vs RETURN UNUSED, Owner sees outstanding spares, BACKUP hardware readiness is separated from customer-specific DELIVERY setup.
